test.create_query: CREATE TABLE tok_log_lines (s String) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO tok_log_lines SELECT concat('2024-01-01 12:00:00.', toString(number % 1000), ' [thread-', toString(number % 64), '] INFO Request processed user_id=', toString(number), ' method=GET path=/api/v1/items/', hex(cityHash64(number)), ' status=200 latency_ms=', toString(number % 500), ' ua="Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64)" ok') FROM numbers(500000)
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE tok_prose (s String) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO tok_prose SELECT concat('Many years later, as he faced the firing squad, Colonel Aureliano Buendia was to remember that distant afternoon when his father took him to discover ice. ', toString(number)) FROM numbers(500000)
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE tok_long_tokens (s String) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO tok_long_tokens SELECT concat(hex(SHA256(toString(number))), ' ', base64Encode(repeat(toString(number), 20)), ' ', hex(cityHash64(number))) FROM numbers(300000)
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE tok_utf8 (s String) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO tok_utf8 SELECT concat('Много лет спустя, стоя у стены в ожидании расстрела, полковник Аурелиано Буэндиа вспомнил тот далекий вечер. ', toString(number)) FROM numbers(300000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM tok_log_lines WHERE NOT ignore(tokens(s)) SETTINGS max_threads = 1

SELECT count() FROM tok_long_tokens WHERE NOT ignore(tokens(s)) SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT count() FROM tok_utf8 WHERE NOT ignore(tokens(s)) SETTINGS max_threads = 1
